claim: Rua do Bojador is closed to road traffic from 6am on Sunday 8 November 2026, per the Parque das Nações parish council.
Some streets around the venue are restricted from 7pm on Sunday 8 November until 11pm on Thursday 12 November.
Carris runs a temporary bus terminal on Avenida D. João II, next to Gare do Oriente, from 8 to 12 November.
Carris's 'Shuttle Web Summit' runs between Praça do Comércio and Oriente from Monday 9 to Thursday 12 November, as reported by Lusa.
Oriente metro station is about 300 metres from the MEO Arena, according to Web Summit.
Oriente metro station is about 600 metres from registration at Pavilhão de Portugal, according to Web Summit.
The Parque das Nações parish council issued its closures notice on 6 November 2026.
Alameda dos Oceanos (downhill direction) is closed every day from 7am to midnight.
Avenida da Boa Esperança is closed from 7am to 10pm, with local access kept.
Avenida do Índico is closed from 7am to 10pm, with a diversion by Rua do Polo Norte.
Rua do Mar Vermelho, Rua do Mar da China and Avenida do Atlântico have no traffic from 7am to 10pm.
Ride-hailing cars have drop-off and pick-up areas on Rua do Caribe and on Alameda dos Oceanos next to the Rotunda dos Vice-Reis.
